question: RK Bijapure played which of the following musical instruments?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Harmonium**__. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **RK Bijapure** played **Harmonium musical instrument**.
 
• In Kagwad (**Belgaum district, Karnataka state, India**), Bijapure was born in **1917**.
 
• Bijapure worked in the drama company of **Venkobrao Shirahatti **as a harmonium player and music director.
 
• RK Bijapure started **“Shri Ram Sangeet Mahavidyalaya”** in **1938**.​​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Harmonium** is a** keyboard** instrument.

 
 
• It produces sound by** blowing air** through reeds.
 
 
 
• **Tabla **is a **percussion** instrument.
 
 
• It is played by** striking the surface** with the fingers.
 
 
 
• **Ravanahatha** is a **stringed** instrument.
 
 
• It is played with a** bow **and is commonly found in Rajasthan.
 
 
 
• **Sitar** is a **stringed** instrument.
 
 
• It is **plucked **and is commonly used in classical Indian music.
